changelog:
Initial release of unified LLM Gateway.

- Provides a single API key to access 70+ LLMs (e.g., GPT-4, Claude-3, Gemini, Qwen, Deepseek, Grok) via a unified, OpenAI-compatible API.
- Enables multi-model chat, side-by-side comparisons, and automatic fallback between models.
- Supports advanced features: streaming, vision/image analysis, and function calling.
- Includes a CLI tool and minimal Python SDK for easy integration and usage.
- Centralized billing, model switching, and usage tracking across all supported providers.
display_name: One API key for 70+ AI models. Route to GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Deepseek, Grok and more
